quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley criticizes James Dolan's treatment of former NBA players
quotes.excerpt: This make all the other owners look like cowards too, because y'all know he a bad guy.
quotes.quote: In life, you want things to be right, but some things just not right. And this type of situation, what this man did was, I mean, he should have been fine, suspended, or something. And this make all the other owners look like cowards too, because y'all know he a bad guy and y'all just want the money. And I'm just saying, every time I do an interview, I'm going to say it because it's wrong for him to do that. I came now, my ex-players I played with, they can't even talk to me in arena. I went to Atlanta and Cleveland with Patrick, John, Allen, and Clyde. They can't even speak to me.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley

quotes.quote: Patrick always been like that. He never stood up for nobody. Even when they offered him the D-League job, I said something. And the coldest thing out of this all, I took a case for Patrick on an airplane. Put that out there. I took a case from him. Ask any teammate, Chris Childs, Charles, Allen, John, they might not say nothing, but I took a case to better his self. And this happened to me, he don't say nothing.
